goal: Generate a highly complete character relationship diagram for a sci-fi IP, in a 3:4 vertical format, styled as a modern information poster with a slightly hard sci-fi cool color tone.

ip.name: The Three-body (core character relationships of the series)
ip.tone: Calm rationality + slight apocalyptic bleakness, avatar is a stylized non-realistic cartoonish image

characters.count: Background gear detail density exceeds the character’s face.
characters.rule: The following 9 people have been designated
characters.user_list: Ye Wenjie, Shi Qiang, Wang Miao, Luo Ji, Zhang Beihai, Cheng Xin, Thomas Wade, Zhizi (personified figure in black), Yun Tianming

components: Rounded Square Card Avatar Small Image

composition.structure: Dual-axis layout: Upper area Ye Wenjie and Hong'an clues slightly left, middle area Wang Miao - Shi Qiang - Luo Ji as Earth-side triangle, lower area Zhang Beihai - Cheng Xin - Wei De - Yun Tianming for step plan and end line, Zhizi card placed in the far right background to create a sense of surveillance
composition.hierarchy: Cards for Luo Ji and Ye Wenjie slightly larger, others medium size, Zhizi can be slightly smaller but with lines emphasizing radial relationships

relationships.annotation_rule: Each line has 3 to 6 character annotations in the middle, such as 'Wall Facers', 'Sword Bearer', 'Starship International', etc.

title_block.main_title: Three-body: A diagram of character relationships
title_block.subtitle: From Red Shore to Dark Forest.

style.art_style: Hard Sci-Fi flat style avatar + modern grid and fine line background.
style.color_palette: Deep space blue gray, stardust white, warning orange, electric cyan accents

must_keep: The visual weight of the main character group is greater than secondary nodes.
Line Types Correspond One-to-One with Legend, Annotations Are Short and Readable
avoid: Yarn Ball Style Crossing with No Layers
More than 6 types of line shapes on the same screen
Label font size is smaller than the name.
